# Razi's Experiments Lab

> A creative coding lab exploring shaders, 3D graphics, animation, and interaction design. Each experiment is isolated, interactive, and close to publishable.

## Articles
- [Basketball Replay Center](https://www.razisyed.cv/experiments/basketball-replay-center/article): Building a sports control room preloader with CRT shaders, barrel distortion, and GSAP-driven uniform animation in React Three Fiber
  - Markdown: https://www.razisyed.cv/experiments/basketball-replay-center/article.mdx
- [Non-Euclidean Hyperbolic Second Brain](https://www.razisyed.cv/experiments/non-euclidean-hyperbolic-workspace/article): Building a non-Euclidean second brain on the Poincaré disk: Möbius transforms, geodesic arcs, conformal scaling, and why hyperbolic geometry is a better fit for knowledge graphs than anything Obsidian does
  - Markdown: https://www.razisyed.cv/experiments/non-euclidean-hyperbolic-workspace/article.mdx
- [Velocity-Responsive Design](https://www.razisyed.cv/experiments/velocity-responsive-design/article): What if responsive design responded to how you read, not just what you read on?
  - Markdown: https://www.razisyed.cv/experiments/velocity-responsive-design/article.mdx
- [404 Not Found](https://www.razisyed.cv/experiments/404-not-found/article): Building a cinematic 404 page with procedurally animated 3D ribbons, a dual-face GLSL shader, and scroll-velocity-driven text animation in React Three Fiber
  - Markdown: https://www.razisyed.cv/experiments/404-not-found/article.mdx

## Experiments
- [Airplanes](https://www.razisyed.cv/experiments/airplanes): Scroll-driven 3D airplane storytelling with dual solid/wireframe rendering, parallax backgrounds, and SVG line drawing annotations
- [Basketball Replay Center](https://www.razisyed.cv/experiments/basketball-replay-center): A WebGL preloader recreating a sports control room, with a CRT screen grid, custom distortion shaders, post-processing, and GSAP animations.
- [Bugged Out Game of Life Shader](https://www.razisyed.cv/experiments/bugged-out-game-of-life-shader-experiment): A variant of the Game of Life shader accidentally counting the decaying ghost trails as living neighbors
- [Cursor/Tilt Depth Map Explorer](https://www.razisyed.cv/experiments/cursor-depth-explorer): A tomographic slice style depth map viewer for paintings using your cursor or device tilt (try on mobile too!)
- [Game of Life Shader](https://www.razisyed.cv/experiments/game-of-life-shader): An attempt to implement Conway's Game of Life with the logic defining the shader
- [Keyboard Keys](https://www.razisyed.cv/experiments/keyboard-keys): Interactive 3D keyboard keys with press animation and success/error animations
- [Life 3D](https://www.razisyed.cv/experiments/life-3d): Autonomous voxel Game of Life evolution in cubic space with high-fidelity cinematic rendering
- [Luma Morphing](https://www.razisyed.cv/experiments/luma-morphing): Canvas 2D morphing effect inspired by the Luma Dream Machine website.
- [Mountain Depth Map Shader Transition](https://www.razisyed.cv/experiments/mountain-transition): A cinematic scene transition using a depth map and FBM noise to create a volumetric reveal that respects the 3D structure of the landscape
- [Non-Euclidean Hyperbolic Second Brain](https://www.razisyed.cv/experiments/non-euclidean-hyperbolic-workspace): Navigate infinite information density on a Poincaré disk using non-Euclidean geometry and Möbius transformations
- [OSX Cheetah UI with a surprise](https://www.razisyed.cv/experiments/gravity-physics-ui-layout): Find the hidden stupid feature!
- [rabbithole.chat Gallery Explore](https://www.razisyed.cv/experiments/rabbithole-chat-gallery-explore): 3D floating gallery shader as an experimental explore page
- [rabbithole.chat Preloader Shader](https://www.razisyed.cv/experiments/rabbithole-chat-preloader): A vortex gallery shader preloader for rabbithole.chat
- [Send Button](https://www.razisyed.cv/experiments/send-button): A cool animated send button animation
- [Shader Landing](https://www.razisyed.cv/experiments/shader-landing): A random shader experiment
- [Terminal Cat](https://www.razisyed.cv/experiments/terminal-cat): Animating ASCII art in the browser console logs
- [Transit/Airport Split-Flap Display](https://www.razisyed.cv/experiments/transit-airport-split-flap-display): A split flap display for transit/airport systems with sound effects manually made with Web Audio API
- [Velocity-Responsive Design](https://www.razisyed.cv/experiments/velocity-responsive-design): A 'Relativistic Reader' that adapts content density and layout based on the user's scroll speed
- [404 Not Found](https://www.razisyed.cv/experiments/404-not-found): A cinematic 404 experience with procedurally animated 3D ribbons and custom GLSL shader effects.

## Technical Details
- Built with Next.js 16+ (App Router), React 19+, TypeScript
- Animation: Motion (motion/react), GSAP with ScrollTrigger
- 3D: React Three Fiber, Three.js, custom GLSL shaders
- Scroll: Lenis smooth scroll with Tempus RAF management
- Styling: Tailwind CSS with shadcn/ui components

## Content API
- Append `.mdx` to any experiment URL for a markdown summary: /experiments/{slug}.mdx
- Append `.mdx` to any article URL for markdown content: /experiments/{slug}/article.mdx
- Send `Accept: text/markdown` header to any article URL to get markdown automatically
- Registry docs: https://www.razisyed.cv/registry/docs (browsable) or https://www.razisyed.cv/registry/llms.txt
